summary: Aurora Mobile filed a Form 6-K furnishing third-quarter 2026 unaudited results and an exhibit announcing a share repurchase program of up to US$10 million. Q3 revenue was RMB106.5 million (US$15.9 million), up 17% year-over-year, gross profit RMB70.9 million, and net income RMB4.5 million, the sixth consecutive US GAAP profitable quarter. No price, premium, stake, or close date was disclosed. The 6-K is incorporated by reference into the company's F-3 registration statements. Routine earnings-plus-buyback disclosure, not a special situation; watch buyback execution pace and liquidity.
